# Vendor packages (launcher installer)

The launcher bundles **BepInEx 5.4.23.5 x64** for one-click install.

Download (not committed — ~640 KB):

```powershell
.\tools\fetch-vendor.ps1
```

Or manually save as `BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip` from:
https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v5.4.23.5/BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip
